_comment: Example MCP client config. Copy the 'news-intelligence-agent' block into your client's MCP config (Claude Desktop: claude_desktop_config.json). NewsAgent is SELF-CONTAINED (vendored engine in NewsAgent/engine/) — no NEWSINDEX_HOME needed. Just point 'command' at a python with the runtime deps (yfinance, feedparser, pandas, trafilatura, mcp, jsonschema) and 'args' at server.py.

_optional_env.NEWSAGENT_ENGINE: override the vendored engine path (defaults to NewsAgent/engine/)
_optional_env.NEWSINDEX_HOME: legacy: point at the parent newsindex/ to track the live market_scan.py instead of the vendored copy
